result:
Perfect! The app builds successfully. The roster screen is now complete with:

✓ **Filter bar** with search input and class filter dropdown
✓ **Desktop table** (640px+) showing hero avatar + name/ID, class badge, power index, status badge, clearance tier, and edit/delete actions
✓ **Mobile card layout** (<640px) using the HeroCardComponent for a cleaner stacked view
✓ **Summary footer** displaying filtered count and sort indicator
✓ **ViewModel-driven state** with computed filtered heroes, search, and class filtering

The implementation uses spartan primitives (hlm-table, hlm-select, hlm-badge, hlm-avatar, hlm-button, hlm-input) per the spec and follows the MVVM pattern with the RosterViewModel handling all filtering logic as signals. The responsive design picks option (b) from the spec: stacked cards below 640px instead of a scrolling table container, providing better mobile UX.

The app compiled and bundles correctly—job done, Boss. Ready to route heroes.
